summary: Two findings. One sits on a changed line and carries an inline anchor; the other is about a file the change only reads, so it has evidence but no anchor.

findings.scenario: A comparison whose file list is empty reaches the matcher, which treats the empty list as allowing every path.
findings.consequence: A review publishes inline comments on files outside the frozen review scope.
findings.action: Reject an empty rule set before matching instead of defaulting to allow.
findings.explanation: The new early return turns an empty rule set into an unconditional allow.

findings.scenario: No test covers a rule set that matches zero patterns, so the behaviour the change relies on is unpinned today.
findings.consequence: A later refactor can flip the fail-closed default without any test failing.
findings.action: Add a case asserting that an empty rule set refuses every path.
findings.explanation: The existing suite only exercises rule sets that match at least one pattern.
